desertification.def: The degrading of dry land until it can support far fewer plants, animals and people, linked to drought, overgrazing and clearing, as in parts of the Sahel.

salinization.def: The buildup of salt in soil, often after years of irrigation in hot, dry places where water evaporates and leaves its salts behind.

terracing.def: Cutting a hillside into flat steps so it can be farmed and so soil and water stay in place, as on the Ifugao rice terraces of the Philippines.

deforestation.def: The clearing of forest, often for farms, pasture or wood, as in parts of the Amazon basin of Brazil.
